game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: In Obsidian Quarry, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the energy value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about energy to power up the forge smith and open the ember furnace.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
